content: My FTP test came back at 260 watts last night.

Nice result—**260 W FTP**, or about **3.71 W/kg** at 70 kg. I’ve saved it as your new tested baseline and will use it for future power targets; intervals.icu still shows **250 W**, so update your FTP there to keep its zones and load calculations aligned.
Given that, how should Thursday's intervals change?

Keep the **same interval structure and %FTP targets**; only recalculate power from **250 W to 260 W**—a **4% increase**. For example, a target previously shown as 225 W becomes 234 W.

Your latest form is **+7**, so there’s no recovery-data reason to reduce Thursday’s intensity, though residual fatigue from Sunday’s FTP test should be considered by feel. I don’t see a Thursday workout on your intervals.icu calendar—send me the interval structure or targets and I’ll recalculate each step precisely.
And remind me what my current weekly Load target is.
I don’t have a current weekly Load target recorded, and there’s no saved training plan to derive one from. So I can’t reliably remind you of a number without inventing it.
